card.name: Linking words before meal or food
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "to" or "after" that come right before a word like meal or food, mainly in dosing sentences about taking a drug with or without food. Also fires on some drug-name pieces in food-related administration sections.

modes.label: Without regard to meals
modes.description: The word "to" in "without regard to" just before meals or food.
modes.example: Meloxicam may be taken without regard<< to>> timing of meals.

modes.label: With or after a meal
modes.description: The word "after" in "with or immediately after" a high-fat meal.
modes.example: Should not be taken with or immediately<< after>> a high-fat meal.

modes.label: Drug-name pieces in food sections
modes.description: Part of a drug name or section number in administration headings about food.
